confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Avignon and Provence, not live listings or menus. July is peak season with the Festival d'Avignon, so accommodation anchors are set at high-season levels and include taxe de sejour. Restaurant anchors are rougher than accommodation for the city's historic-centre bistros. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are rough; cocktail and wine were set relative to beer. The FX rate comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA statistics page and a third-party copy. I did not read the rba.gov.au table directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Provence tourism towns such as Arles, Aix-en-Provence and Nimes, adjusted for Avignon's July festival demand and its historic-centre hotel supply.
